labels.label: R2-FALLBACK-SURVIVES / H-ABSORBS
labels.sentence: against a free encoding that is never at the marginal (the model's own routers replayed on the token embedding as the prior of the smoothed count tables), the address block still adds a material margin over the equal-dims free block on the unseen-key positions: the located margin is not shown to be table sparsity at this encoding and the coverage caveat stands as a scoped limitation, not a retraction, at this reader (B = 16, j = 1); the pooled Q1 reading's CI95 straddles the +0.05 floor; with the forward's final-norm state at the address block's width in the free arm, no material margin (at or above +0.05) of the address block over the equal-dims free block is shown and none of the address stream over the free bigram plus the hidden block: at this reader the forward's own final-norm state plus two tokens' smoothed routing profiles show no material address margin (NON-CRITERION; K-2 is untouched), at this reader (B = 16, j = 1)
labels.rule: readings SIGNAL iff CI95 lower > 0 and delta >= +0.05, NEGATIVE iff CI95 upper < 0, else NOT-SHOWN, at B=16, j=1, on the twin's bigram positions split by train-table coverage (six strata; covered / fallback / all); PRECONDITION REPRODUCE: this read's rows for the twin's nine arms equal the committed stratified read's rows per stratum (hits-only mismatches on at most 0.1% of them within +-1 hit are NEAR; more, any needed mismatch, or a twin D_eq on all / covered / fallback that is not the stratified payload's is INVALID = void, numbers only); the free arm's k and lambda selected jointly on val (strict >, smaller k then smaller lambda on ties); Q1 R2-FALLBACK-SURVIVES iff history_tok_r2 - free_r2 on fallback SIGNAL, R2-POOLED-ONLY iff not and on all SIGNAL, else R2-ABSORBED; Q2 on all positions: H-SURVIVES iff history_bigram_r2 - free_h and history_all_h - free_h both SIGNAL, H-COMPLEMENTARY iff only the union, H-ABSORBS iff neither, H-INCONSISTENT iff only the equal-dims; a CI95 containing +0.05 is a floor straddle, flagged, and on the fallback gate or either Q2 reading the pinned sentence then claims nothing beyond the rule; READER GUARD: where free_h - free_r2 or history_all_h - history_bigram_r2 on all reads NEGATIVE the Q2 label stays but its branch sentence is replaced and nothing is struck; a NEGATIVE D_eq^H and a NEGATIVE D_add^H each carry their own prefix; the ABSORBED sentence's sparsity clause needs shrinkage on fallback SIGNAL (else a no-gain clause), is replaced where k is the pure-replay end, and is extended where history_tok_r2 - history_tok on all or on fallback reads NEGATIVE; the primary harvest's label is the label; NON-CRITERION, one pinned consequence (a dated STATUS line under F-26)
